description: Say where pages go (Plinth), list Plinth @mention requests waiting when a session starts, and in T3 Code bring later ones to the session through the mention relay

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook claude session-start 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook claude post-tool 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook claude session-end 2>/dev/null; exit 0
